Markets.title: Gold jumps 2% as Fed Governor Waller's comments temper rate hike bets
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over 2% after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated support for keeping interest rates steady if inflation continues to cool. This shift in expectations lowered Treasury yields and weakened the dollar, further boosting bullion as investors awaited upcoming US economic data.

Markets.title: Fed's Waller says safety premium for Treasuries is gone, pushing neutral rate higher
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that the loss of the safety premium on U.S. Treasuries is driving up the neutral interest rate and keeping borrowing costs high. He also warned that the U.S. cannot outgrow its $40 trillion debt without addressing its structural deficits.

Markets.title: US 30-year mortgage rate hits highest level in more than a year
Markets.summary: US 30-year mortgage rates have reached their highest level in over a year, increasing affordability challenges for homebuyers. This increase is driven by elevated Treasury yields resulting from inflation concerns, government borrowing needs, and Middle East tensions.

Markets.title: Calcutta exchange’s unlisted shares double on revival hopes
Markets.summary: Shares of the Calcutta Stock Exchange have more than doubled in the unlisted market over the past three months due to growing revival hopes. The exchange plans to pause its voluntary exit process to explore trading across multiple asset classes, pending regulatory approval and anchor investors.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: The Indian stock market closed lower on Thursday, with the Sensex falling 417 points and the Nifty dropping 41 points due to high oil prices, bond yields, and geopolitical tensions. Near-term market direction will depend on ongoing global risks and crude oil volatility despite strong domestic growth.

Markets.title: Sebi to review derivatives settlement price methodology after CAS volatility
Markets.summary: SEBI will review derivative settlement price methodology following market feedback about sudden option price swings during the Closing Auction Session. The regulator plans to issue a consultation paper soon regarding proposed changes to address expiry-day volatility.

Geo-Political.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
Geo-Political.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warns that a severe El Niño weather event is forming and will likely disrupt global economies. Governments worldwide are now preparing for the impacts of this phenomenon.

Geo-Political.title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
Geo-Political.summary: Toxic wildfire haze spreading across Southeast Asia has exposed millions of people to dangerous smog. Over 12,000 children have suffered respiratory issues as a result of the intensified El Niño weather pattern.

Geo-Political.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
Geo-Political.summary: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Her foundation announced that she passed away peacefully at her New York City home surrounded by loved ones.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Palestinian officials report that two teens were killed during an Israeli settler attack on the West Bank village of Al-Mughayyir. The village council states the victims were trying to stop settlers from stealing sheep, while the Israeli military claims they threw stones at its troops.

Geo-Political.title: 'Beautiful, vibrant' Disney star Carla Jeffery dies aged 33
Geo-Political.summary: Carla Jeffery, known for her role as cheerleader Bree in the Disney Channel movie *Zombies* and its sequels, has died at the age of 33. Her cause of death was not mentioned in the report.

Geo-Political.title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers off the Canary Islands saved 44 survivors from a migrant boat but had to leave five bodies behind due to bad weather. More than 80 additional migrants are feared dead from the voyage.

AI & Tech.summary: An author tested ChatGPT to see if their WordPress SaaS course appeared in AI-generated answers. The AI recommended their course as the top result without any paid advertising.

Data & Insights.title: Fed's Waller signals patience on rates, but keeps hike on table if inflation heats up
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated he is in no rush to cut interest rates and is closely watching upcoming inflation data. He also mentioned that the Fed could still raise interest rates if inflation fails to cool down further.

Data & Insights.title: Cong again questions India's ‘chest-thumping’ 7.8% GDP growth, demands answers on  ₹43 lakh crore revision
Data & Insights.summary: The Congress party questioned the government's reported 7.8% GDP growth rate and demanded an explanation for a ₹43 lakh crore reduction in the estimated size of the economy. The opposition also asked the government to clarify the methodology used to make this significant revision.

Data & Insights.title: Raghuram Rajan clarifies his stand on GDP: If growth is strong, why aren’t private investment, FDI and jobs rising?
Data & Insights.summary: Economist Raghuram Rajan stated that he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's official GDP growth figures. However, he expressed confusion over why this reported growth is not resulting in increased private investment, foreign direct investment, or job creation.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal calls for nationwide push to unlock export benefits under FTAs
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged a nationwide push to help businesses fully utilize India's free trade agreements. These nine FTAs currently provide preferential market access across economies representing roughly $60 trillion in global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Neelkanth Mishra rejects base-revision concerns over 7.8% GDP growth, says, 'several indicators hard to manipulate'
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank's Neelkanth Mishra defended India's 7.8% GDP growth rate against claims questioning its accuracy. He asserted that the growth data is reliable because several underlying economic indicators are difficult to manipulate.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What is the confusion over GDP growth numbers?
Data & Insights.summary: Opposition parties and experts are questioning the accuracy of the government's latest Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data. Mint analyzes these allegations to determine if the concerns regarding the growth numbers have any merit.

India.title: Two-Time Punjab MP Dharamvira Gandhi's Name Not On Draft Electoral Rolls After SIR
India.summary: Two-time Punjab MP Dharamvira Gandhi and his family members discovered their names were missing from the draft electoral rolls following the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). Dr Gandhi has raised objections and submitted the required documents to ensure their names are restored in the final voter lists.

India.title: Don't Politicise Ajit Pawar's Death: Sunetra Pawar After Supriya Sule's Jibe
India.summary: Sunetra Pawar has urged people not to politicize the death of her husband, Ajit Pawar. Her statement responds to criticism from Supriya Sule, who accused Ajit Pawar's faction of enjoying power after the tragedy.

India.title: Family Blames Harassment By Woman For Guwahati Doctor's Death
India.summary: The family of a deceased Guwahati doctor has blamed a woman for harassing him prior to his death. They alleged that the woman frequently visited his workplace and threatened to harm herself.

India.title: "Not Mature": Mayawati Pushes Nephew Akash Anand To The Margins Again. What It Means For BSP
India.summary: BSP chief Mayawati has sidelined her 31-year-old nephew and political successor, Akash Anand, for the third time in three years. Mayawati reportedly deemed Anand "not mature" during a party meeting in Lucknow on September 3.

India.title: Assam Police To Get 15,000-20,000 Recruits, 5,000 Promotions: Himanta Sarma
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma announced that the state police force will add 15,000 to 20,000 new recruits and implement 5,000 promotions. He also reported that the police conviction rate rose from roughly 8 percent in 2020 to 29.30 percent currently.

India.title: "Because Of Pain": Madhya Pradesh Cop Alleges Salary Hold Amid Illness
India.summary: Madhya Pradesh police officer Pooja Raghuvanshi has alleged that her salary was withheld while she undergoes continuous treatment for acute spinal pain. She stated that she has been suffering from this condition for the past five to six months.

General.title: Reform UK promises £80bn cuts to public spending
General.summary: At the party's conference, economy spokesman Robert Jenrick announced that Reform UK plans to cut public spending by £80bn. He stated that these measures will establish the party as the champion of fiscal responsibility.

General.title: Trump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war support
General.summary: President Trump suggested the United States would not support the UK in a future conflict over the Falkland Islands. He based this on the UK's failure to assist the US in its ongoing conflict with Iran.

General.title: Watch: Gloria Steinem dedicated her life to fight for women's equality
General.summary: Feminist icon and women's liberation leader Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Her death on Wednesday was announced by her foundation.
